A block marker on a continuation line of a link label is escaped

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<a href="https://example.com">Alpha<br>-<br>Beta</a>'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
